source_clauses: release exactly one each time I press a lever
so I never get two at once
refill it from the top without taking it off the wall
must not jam when it is nearly empty

requirements.statement: The dispenser must hold approximately twenty items.
The dispenser must release exactly one item each time the lever is pressed.
The dispenser must not release more than one item at a time.
The dispenser must be refillable from the top without being taken off the wall.
The dispenser must not jam when it is nearly empty.

scenarios.description: User presses a lever to dispense one item.
User refills the dispenser from the top while it remains mounted on the wall.

actors.name: user
actors.description: presses the lever to dispense items

freedoms: The mechanism for releasing exactly one item is not specified.
The method for wall-mounting is not specified.
The material of the dispenser is not specified.
The dimensions of the dispenser are not specified.
The items are not specified beyond being small.
ambiguities: The exact meaning of 'about twenty' is not defined.
The condition 'when it is nearly empty' is not precisely defined.

It is unclear whether the dispenser must release exactly one item per press or if it must also prevent multiple items from being released together in other scenarios, but the phrase 'so I never get two at once' suggests a strict no-multiple-release requirement.
The type of lever (e.g., hand or foot) is not specified.
assumptions: The user presses the lever with a finger or hand.
The dispenser is intended for indoor use.
The small items are of uniform size and shape, but this is not stated.
